entities.summary: Western philosophy refers to the philosophical thought, traditions, and works of the Western world. Historically, the term refers to the philosophical thinking of Western culture, beginning with the ancient Greek philosophy of the pre-Socratics. The word philosophy itself originated from the Ancient Greek φιλοσοφία, literally, 'the love of wisdom', from Ancient Greek: φιλεῖν, 'to love', and σοφία (sophía), 'wisdom'.
